## Flashed Colour → Buttons

For each flashed colour, press the button(s) shown, in order.


| Colour flashed | Press |
| --- | --- |
| Red | Blue |
| Yellow | Green + Green |
| Green | Red |
| Blue | Yellow + Yellow |
